# Windows maintenance audit - Audit
DESKTOP-EXAMPLE - standard user - read-only - 27.3s
- Windows 11 Pro 25H2 - Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8C/16T - 32 GB DDR5 - Radeon RX 7900 XT
## Findings (1 high, 3 medium, 9 total)
high health 3 WHEA hardware error events in 14 days -> test at stock settings
medium gaming Display at 60 Hz, panel reports up to 165 Hz -> Settings > Display
medium gaming DDR5 at 4800 MT/s (JEDEC base) -> enable EXPO in BIOS yourself
medium startup 19 programs start at sign-in, 6 look optional -> Debloat mode
low gaming Power plan 'Ultimate Performance', not Balanced -> SetPowerPlan
## Recoverable storage (estimate, nothing deleted)
- Tier 1 (low risk): 4.82 GB Tier 2 (has a cost): 2.10 GB Tier 3 (your files): 12.4 GB
| Id | Target | Tier | Est. recoverable | Notes |
| user-temp | User temp folder | 1 | 1.21 GB | |
| chrome-cache | Google Chrome cache | 1 | 912.4 MB | close: chrome |
| windows-temp | Windows temp folder | 1 | 644.0 MB | needs admin |
| gpu-shader-cache | GPU driver shader caches | 2 | 1.48 GB | recompiles |
| recycle-bin | Recycle Bin | 3 | 12.4 GB | your files |
## Gaming
- Detected (protected): steam, xboxApp, gameBar, amdAdrenalin, sunshine, obs
- Anti-cheat (protected): EasyAntiCheat_EOS, BEService, vgc
